company.shortDescription: Fractional is a social platform for fractional ownership of the real estate.
company.description: Fractional is a social platform for fractional ownership of the real estate. The company develops an investment application to reduce the cost of entry and time commitment for property investing and also lets the users directly own fractions of investment properties and visualize the returns, cash flow, and costs of properties on the marketplace.

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that facilitates fractional ownership and co-ownership of real estate investment properties by connecting individuals to invest together.
productsAndServices.name: Fractional Platform

productsAndServices.description: An invite-only accelerator program that offers mentorship, live deal reviews, and community support to help professionals improve their real estate investing skills and scale their investment projects.
productsAndServices.name: Accelerate Program

productsAndServices.description: Financial account management and payment processing services that handle funds for property investments, including deposits, distributions, and transfers, facilitated through partnerships with Stripe and Fifth Third Bank.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Account and Payment Services

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $15,000,000, or 73.17% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,149,412 to $98,257,627, a 19.08x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 88 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 75 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
